subject: [PATCH RESEND 0/7] locking: opt-in tracking of sleeping lock holders

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledges that the patch series is causing confusion due to its scope, promises to start a discussion email to clarify and involve relevant parties.
reviews.raw_body:
I think I should have started a conversation/discussion email before sending out
the multiple patch series which kind of doing multiple overlapping things and it

2026-10-01.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a mechanism to track sleeping lock holders in the Linux kernel. It allows locks to opt-in to being tracked, and stores a count of these locks in task_struct. This is intended to help solve isolation failures caused by shared locks, where one workload's pressure can leak into another unrelated workload. The solution aims to improve performance by allowing the allocator to treat tasks holding widely shared locks differently, especially under memory or CPU pressure.
